title: Script Entry
statement: Implement `solve(spec)`. `spec` is `module:function`. Return `[module, function]`. If there is not exactly one colon, or either side is empty, return `error`.
hints: Split on colon once and check the remainder has none... or count colons.

approaches.name: Direct
approaches.explanation: A console script entry point is module:function.

editorial: A console script entry point is module:function. The installer builds a small launcher that imports the module and calls the function. A missing colon or an empty side is a broken pyproject table, and it should fail at packaging time rather than when a user runs the command.
